android.title: New name on the phone start-up
items: Phones: the start-up animation shows the new name, Cinema Premiere IPTV Player

android.title: A new name: Cinema Premiere IPTV Player
items: The app is now called Cinema Premiere IPTV Player (in your apps list, Settings and Help & about)

android.title: Phone top bar and a darker side menu
items: Phones: when you scroll the Cinema Premiere home, a see-through bar with Cinema Premiere and Search stays at the top
Android TV: the Cinema Premiere side menu is darker, so the words stand out

android.title: Search posters appear faster
items: Search: posters of the results now appear much faster, also for titles that have no picture from your service

android.title: A brand-new, fast Search
items: Android TV: a new Search screen - small keyboard on the left, posters on the right, and the highlighted poster shows its story, year, length and genres
Search is now much faster: results appear as you type
Search looks only in movies and series (all your TV services)

android.title: Search everything
items: Search now finds movies, series AND live channels in all your TV services
TV: a "See all results" button jumps straight to the full list
Phones: a search button at the top of the Cinema Premiere home

android.title: Score cards: pick your team on the TV
items: Settings > Home screen > Score cards: pressing a league now opens its team list on Android TV
Phones: long collection names (like "Critically Acclaimed Series") now have comfortable space between their lines

android.title: A cleaner Cinema Premiere
items: Cinema Premiere: the side menu now stays hidden; a tiny arrow at the left edge shows it is there - press Left at the start of a row to open it
The rows now line up exactly with the featured movies and series at the top

android.title: Movie pages load their details again
items: Movie and series pages load their details, cast and awards right away again (a slow answer is tried again before giving up)
The poster safety net now works quietly in the background, one title at a time, and never slows the app
A picture is replaced only when it is really missing, not when the TV is just busy

android.title: Posters everywhere
items: Movies and Series: a title without a picture, or with a broken one, now shows its official poster from the movie database.

android.title: A poster for every title
items: Cinema Premiere: a movie or series without a picture from your TV service now gets its official poster from the movie database.

android.title: Back to the top, and every award poster
items: Cinema Premiere: Back anywhere in the rows takes you straight to the top; Back again asks to exit.
Oscar, Emmy and Golden Globe collections now always show their posters.
The highlighted poster pops out a little more, while the others dim gently.
Movies: one press of Back closes the "Continue or start from the beginning" box.
The first screen now features up to 10 movies and shows.

android.title: Gentler spotlight and 10 featured titles
items: Cinema Premiere: the other posters dim more gently around the one you are on.
Posters and cards that did not load the first time are tried again, so they no longer stay empty.
Movies: one press of Back now closes the "Continue or start from the beginning" box.
Cinema Premiere: the first screen now features up to 10 movies and shows.

android.title: Always know where you are
items: Cinema Premiere: the poster or card you are on glows softly, and the others dim gently, so the highlight is easy to spot.

android.title: A smaller, lighter side menu
items: Cinema Premiere: the side menu is smaller, without Home, and the white highlight is just as wide as the word.
Coming back from Live TV, Movies or Series returns you to the same row.
Smoother: background work pauses while you move around.

android.title: A more polished side menu
items: Cinema Premiere: the side menu icons appear as soon as you reach the rows, and the rows move aside so nothing overlaps.
The menu now opens from the centre with a smooth, gentle pop.

android.title: A slim side menu in Cinema Premiere
items: Cinema Premiere: when you scroll down, small icons wait at the left; press Left to open the menu (Live TV, Movies, Series, Sports, Search, Settings).
Closing the menu takes you back to the same tile.

android.title: Weather and clock in Cinema Premiere
items: Cinema Premiere: the top right now shows the weather, the time and the date in a slim gold design.

android.title: Clearer Sports note on phones
items: Phone Settings: "Sports on the home screen" now says these cards are not on the Cinema Premiere home.

android.title: Small clock in Settings, tidier buttons
items: Settings: a small clock and date at the top right (it follows the 24-hour setting).
Phone: on a movie or series page, Watch now is never cut off.
Sports: during a live game the buttons are the same size as before the game.
Sports: no more score pop-up box at the top right.

android.title: A simpler top menu
items: Premiere home: the top menu no longer has a Home button (you are already on Home).
Collection cards no longer show a title count; the total is shown inside each collection.

android.title: Smooth version list, exact totals
items: Choose a version: no more flicker on the line you just left.
Collection and genre totals always include every TV service you added, so the card and the page show the same number.

android.title: Every card shows the real total
items: Every collection card, including the big seasonal one, now shows the same total as its page.
Collections are counted quietly in the background while the Premiere home is open.
Settings: the "Updated" date is always the real date the app was updated.

android.title: Totals that always match
items: Premiere home: the top menu stays perfectly still when you come back from a section.
The total on each collection card now matches the total inside the page.
Category and Actors and Directors pages remember what they found even after the app is closed; new ones are added quietly.

android.title: Categories remember their totals
items: Genre and collection pages remember everything they found, so they open with the full total right away.
New movies and series are added quietly in the background; nothing is searched again from the start.
Premiere home: coming back from Live TV, Movies or Series, the top menu stays on the button you used, with no jump from Home.

android.title: A cleaner top bar
items: Poster pages: the top bar now fades softly into the posters, like the side menu.
The page name always shows in full, and the highlighted movie stays in one place on the left with its year and IMDb score.
Premiere home: the highlight in the top menu now glides to the button you are on.

android.title: Back to the same poster
items: Genre, collection, actor and franchise pages: going back from a movie returns you to the same poster.
Pages with only movies or only series now show their total too.
Poster pages: a slim bar stays at the top while you scroll, with the page name, the total and the highlighted title.
Live TV: no more empty space above the channels.

android.title: Sports buttons
items: Sports: the buttons are round and easy to read again, and the team name is never cut off.
Sports: the Remind me button is gone.

android.title: The same icons on every device
items: The app's icons now look exactly the same on every TV and phone.
Settings: a clear blue sign for About.
Live TV: a smaller clock and date under the preview.
Phone: going back in the Premiere theme returns you to the same row instead of the top.

android.title: Live TV that remembers your channel
items: Live TV: going back to the channels (Right from the groups, or Left from the preview) lands on the channel you were on.
Live TV: the channel list moves in whole rows and always starts at the top - no more skipped or half rows.
Live TV: with the TV guide on, the clock and date under the preview always show.
TV guide: turning it off and on again shows the programmes right away.
Browse by Genre: each genre now shows every movie and series from all your TV services, not just the first 120 / 80.
Collections (Hidden Gems, Cult Classics, Family Movie Night and more) keep growing with every match from all your TV services.

android.title: Smoother Settings, guide and windows
items: Speed test: the needle no longer covers the speed numbers, and the result tiles show the full number.
TV guide: programmes never draw on top of each other.
TV guide: no box above the time grid, and Right from the groups goes straight to the channels.
Picture size and Subtitles windows close with one press of Back.
Exit: one press of Yes closes the app, cleanly.
Settings: no more jiggling while moving up and down; a headset icon for Help & about.
Title pages open at the top again (Back from "More like this" still returns to where you were).
Actors and Directors page: sorted A to Z.

android.title: A TV guide for every service
items: TV guide: when your service sends no program information, the app now finds the guide by itself from the free Dan's IPTV guide (Arabic channels such as MBC, Rotana and beIN, the USA, the UK, Canada, all of Europe and many more countries). Turn it on in Settings > Playback.
Works for M3U playlists too, and channels shown a few hours later (like "-6/hr") get their times shifted.
Settings: a new speedometer for the internet speed test, room under the last row of every group, the score-card buttons no longer cut off, and a clearer Help & about icon.
Subtitles & audio: a neater window with shorter language names.

android.title: Faster genres, every version from every account
items: Cinema Premiere: "Choose a version" now finds the copies on all your accounts, matched by the movie's own database number.
Browse by Genre opens quickly again, and the app uses much less memory with several accounts.
The "Recently Added" row is gone from the Premiere home.
Subtitles & audio: one press of Back closes the window.

android.title: TV guide, subtitle languages, all your accounts
items: TV guide: see what is on now and next in Live TV, plus a new Guide view with a time grid. Turn it on in Settings > Playback (off by default).
Movies and series: a "Subtitles & audio" button lets you pick the subtitle language (or Off) and the sound language when the video has them. Your choice is remembered.
Cinema Premiere now looks in all your Xtream accounts, and "Choose a version" shows which account each copy is on. Switching the account in use no longer causes errors.
Smoother on slower TVs: pictures of the next rows load ahead, rows are prepared before you reach them, and a Slow-TV mode gives older TVs a lighter look (automatic).

android.title: Keyboard fixed, neater Top 10 and Settings
items: Search keyboard: round capsule keys again, and the key you are on lights up and pops, so typing is easy to follow.
Top 10: every number is the same size, and number 1 always comes back with the same space at the left edge.
Settings: a more compact group list and a wider right side, so nothing is cut off.

android.title: Settings polish
items: Settings: every group lines up neatly, the sports buttons wrap instead of being cut off, and the stream format and keyboard switches are shorter and clearer.

android.title: New Settings, tidier top bar and keyboard
items: Settings on TV are redesigned in groups: My TV services, Home screen, Playback, Content & search, Internet, and Help & about. Pick a group on the left and its settings show on the right in soft cards.
Help & about now shows the app version and date.
Cinema Premiere: the top bar no longer runs over the "Cinema Premiere" name.
Top 10: the big number 10 now shows beside its poster.
Search keyboard: all the symbols of the TV keyboard, wider buttons for Space, Clear, 123 and Arabic, and one calm dark background.

android.title: Our own search keyboard
items: Cinema Premiere Search has its own keyboard on TV: rounded keys in English or Arabic, a 123 page, title suggestions while you type, your recent searches, and the most likely next letters glow gold.
Arabic is shown in the Noto Naskh Arabic font, and words spelled with or without hamza still match.
Settings: switch between Dan's IPTV keyboard and the TV keyboard.

android.title: Clearer settings, steady click
items: Technical Support: the Website button and code open the top of the website.
Settings: Today's games and Score cards now say clearly that they show on the photo themes only.
Photo themes: the click sound of the bottom bar now plays on every move, slow or fast.

android.title: Choose a version - every time
items: The "Choose a version" window now shows every time a movie or series has several versions, also right after the app starts.
Resume (Continue watching) offers the versions too: keep watching the same one, or switch to another version at the same point.

android.title: Search in Cinema Premiere
items: Cinema Premiere: a Search button in the top bar - find any movie or series in your library while you type.
Collection titles never split a word.
The version list no longer shows the provider's star symbols.
Cast & Crew: no grey box behind the highlighted actor.

android.title: Faster, smoother movement
items: Highlighted tiles pop out quicker, like Apple TV.
The soft background behind the Premiere rows costs the TV much less work while you move.
Fixed: the test version 185 did not open on some TVs.

android.title: Test version (not released)
items: A smaller test build; it did not open on some TVs and was replaced by 186.
Highlighted tiles pop out quicker, like Apple TV.
The soft background behind the Premiere rows costs the TV much less work while you move.

android.title: Choose a version
items: When your service has the same movie or series more than once (4K, Full HD, HD, with or without subtitles, dubbed...), Play now lets you choose the version you want.
Title pages show how many versions are available.
Popular Actors and Directors: a "See more" tile opens a full page with many more actors and directors from your library.
Cleaner actor circles (no grey box when highlighted) and collection titles that never split a word.

android.title: Cleaner rows + website link
items: Premiere on TV: a little more space between each row title and its cards, the same in every row.
Phones: the volume button in the player no longer covers the time.
Technical Support: a Website button and QR code (downloads and update history).
Phones: after this update the app opens on the Cinema Premiere home once (you can still pick another look in Settings > Themes).

android.title: Bigger highlight
items: Premiere: the highlighted poster, card, collection or group pops out bigger, so it is easy to see where you are.

android.title: Back to the same title, no flicker
items: Title pages: after opening a title from "More like this", Back returns to the same tile on that row - no flicker, no jump to the top.
Cast & Crew and More like this rows remember how far you scrolled.
Settings: the clock is now a simple "24-hour clock" On / Off switch.

android.title: Faster, smoother Premiere
items: Title pages open at once again (no more waiting, no more being thrown back to Home).
The whole app runs faster on big services: titles are matched much more quickly and with less work.
Up and down on the Premiere home: one smooth glide, every time.
The version date on the home screen is correct again.

android.title: 12 or 24-hour clock
items: Settings: choose a 12-hour (3:45 PM) or 24-hour (15:45) clock. Every clock and game time in the app follows it.

android.title: Smooth up and down
items: Premiere home: moving up and down is now one quick, smooth glide - no more jitter. Each row moves to the top of the screen.

android.title: Small loading fix
items: A section with no titles now simply shows as empty.
Safety guard: if the Premiere home ever fails to load twice, it pauses for a day so the rest of the app keeps working.

android.title: Premiere home no longer closes the app
items: Fixed: on some TVs the app closed itself while the Premiere home was loading.
Movie and series lists load with much less memory, so big services work smoothly.

android.title: More space between tiles
items: Premiere: tiles keep a clear space between them, also when highlighted, like Apple TV.

android.title: Opens the right movie or series
items: Premiere now opens the exact movie or series from your service (the 2026 one, not an older title with the same name), for every provider.
Apple TV-style cards: no frame, a soft shadow and a small Movie / Series line on the highlighted poster.
Cast & Crew with plain round photos, like Apple TV.

android.title: Back to your highlights
items: Sports Hub: after watching a game highlight, Back returns to the Highlights tab on the same clip.

android.title: Apple TV-style highlight
items: Premiere: the highlighted poster pops out with a soft shadow, like Apple TV.
IMDb scores on the featured titles and title pages.
Continue watching shows the whole poster.
New Collections design: words and posters side by side, never overlapping.
Up from My List goes to More info, then Watch now, then the top bar.

android.title: Premiere: Sports, Back and title pages
items: Sports in the Premiere top bar.
Back takes you to the same row and tile you were on, not the top bar.
Watch now is outlined like More info until you highlight it.
Title pages show the whole cast row on the first screen.
Highlighted tiles never get cut off at the edge of the TV.
Phones: volume control in the player (speaker button, slider panel, mute, or slide along the right edge).
Phones: Sports Hub buttons show every word; big scores stay on one line.
Phones: cleaner Collections cards, Tonight's Pick tiles and page titles.

android.title: Cinema Premiere polish
items: TV: the Premiere home opens on the top bar, so the whole first page shows.
Smaller Watch now / More info / My List buttons; Down from My List starts at Continue watching.
The top bar only moves Left and Right and never jumps to the other end.
One smooth background under the first page.
Going back up on any Premiere page now shows it all the way to the top.

android.title: Cinema Premiere and Sports Hub
items: New Cinema Premiere home on TVs and a full Sports Hub.

android.title: Cinema Premiere, Prime-style
items: The new home is called Cinema Premiere.
A see-through menu in the middle of the top bar, stacked buttons and small dots for the featured titles.
Left / Right flip the featured title; each one stays 5 seconds.
Pressing Down moves the whole first page away so the rows have the full screen.

android.title: Premiere: more for you
items: Because you watched, Recommended for you, Tonight's pick, Got 90 minutes, Epic Nights.
Popular actors and directors, and movie franchises, each with their titles from your library.

android.title: Premiere: collections and genres
items: Award collections (Oscars, Golden Globes, Emmys), seasonal picks and a Browse by Genre row.
A full title page with cast, trailer and More like this.
Premiere is listed first in Settings > Themes.

android.title: Premiere: faster and easier to move around
items: The Premiere home loads much faster and opens at once the next time.
The top menu can now be reached with the remote.

android.title: New Premiere home (TV)
items: A new premium home for movies and series: a moving featured title, Top 10 rows and Continue watching.
TVs switch to it once; phones can choose it in Settings > Themes.

android.title: Sports Hub: channels and alerts
items: Shows which channels carry each game.
Remind me before a game starts, score alerts for your teams, and game highlights.
Today shows only today's games; a game page opens at the top.

android.title: Sports Hub: real game clocks
items: Live games show the real clock and period.
NFL and WNBA added; standings split into East / West conferences.

android.title: New Sports Hub
items: A full Sports screen from Home and the side menu: scores, schedules, standings and team pages.

android.title: Smoother sync and ratings for everyone
items: Continue watching sync is lighter and only downloads your list when something changed.
IMDb scores use their own service for the public app.

android.title: Live games on the sports card
items: A live game of your teams looks like the live games list (score in the middle, clock under it).
Tighter spacing on the home sports card.

android.title: Easier TV Settings
items: In TV Settings, Left / Right stay in the row and never jump to another row.
The side menu no longer opens from Settings; Back goes Home.

android.title: One Back button for every phone
items: Phones: a round Back button (black circle, light-blue ring, white arrow) that looks the same on every phone brand.

android.title: Fast-forward through long lists
items: TV remote: the ⏩ and ⏪ buttons jump through long channel lists and poster grids (Live TV, Movies, Series, Settings).
Inside the players the buttons keep their own job (skip forward / back).

android.title: Recently watched stays honest
items: Live TV grid: resting on a channel no longer adds it to Recently watched - only channels you open full screen are added.

android.title: Season bars that never disappear
items: Series posters: the season / episode bar stays while the app checks for a newer episode.
A lookup that fails is tried again, and many more series are remembered.

android.title: NEW episode bar everywhere
items: The green NEW season / episode bar shows on series posters in every section: its own section, Recently Added, Favorites and search.
New episodes are checked again every 6 hours.

android.title: Calm Settings + compact sports card
items: TV Settings opens without a jump, Back keeps your place, and Up always returns to the top.
"Exit the app?" closes the app instantly.
New compact sports card on the left: your teams with the day and time (a countdown when the game is soon) and a sport drop-down.

android.title: Settings opens without a jump
items: TV Settings opens calmly with no sliding; Back closes an open form first.

android.title: Settings Up / Down without flicker
items: Up / Down in TV Settings jump straight to the next row, with no flicker.

android.title: Exit fixes
items: The Exit the app? question now closes the app on Yes, and starts on No.

android.title: Exit question + one sports card
items: Back on Home asks "Exit the app?" so a second Back by mistake never closes it.
One sports card with team logos; the hourly weather line is gone.

android.title: Add a service with your provider
items: Settings: MAC Address + Device Key + a QR code to add a service through your provider's website.
Live TV grid plays the channel you rest on, inside its tile.
New slim weather + clock bar.
Hide categories lists every saved account.

android.title: Add with Device ID and Device Key
items: Each TV shows its own Device ID and Device Key, so a provider's website can add your playlist.

android.title: Hide categories for every service
items: Hide categories now lists every saved account and playlist.

android.title: Live preview in the channel grid
items: In Grid view the channel you rest on plays inside its tile.
Weather and clock in one glass card on the TV home.

android.title: Clear watch history
items: Settings: Clear watch history (under Hide categories) - clears this device only.
The TV home-screen picture is back to the original.

android.title: New TV home-screen picture
items: A full-width picture on Android TV / Google TV home screens (changed back in 143).

android.title: Small polish
items: ✨ Recently Added icon.
The account in use shows all its details.
Matching icons in the Hide categories list.

android.title: My TV services
items: TV Settings: one "My TV services" section for all your logins and playlists.
Icons for Xtream (📡) and M3U (📋) lists in the Live TV menu.

android.title: My TV services in Settings
items: One clear "My TV services" section at the top of TV Settings.

android.title: Your login is always safe
items: Adding something with your phone never replaces your login.
All your accounts are in the Live TV list menu.

android.title: Add from your phone
items: TV: sign in or add a playlist from your phone by scanning a QR code.

android.title: Add a playlist with your phone
items: Scan a QR code on the TV and type the playlist name and link on your phone.

android.title: Phone sign-in easier to find
items: "Sign in with your phone" now sits at the top of TV Settings.

android.title: Phone + Hide categories polish
items: Phones: a bigger "Continue from" window.
Hide categories: the provider list is on top.

android.title: Several accounts
items: Save several Xtream accounts and switch between them.
Hide categories works for every list.

android.title: Sign in with your phone
items: TV: scan a QR code and type your login on your phone instead of the remote.

android.title: Phone fixes
items: Phones: playlist addresses can be edited, and small fixes.

android.title: Phone welcome + sports
items: Phones: a longer welcome screen and sports cards on every theme.

android.title: Player fixes + gold welcome
items: Phones: Picture size works with taps, drag the time bar to jump, a gold welcome screen.

android.title: Telegram support on TV
items: Technical Support: contact the developer on Telegram (QR code).

android.title: Phone fixes + Telegram
items: Phones: update windows fit upright, a Back button on the players, Telegram support.

android.title: New phone design
items: Phones get their own upright screens (Home, Live TV, Movies, Series, Settings); players turn sideways. TVs unchanged.

android.title: Update window fits phones
items: On phones the update window always fits, with the Download and install button visible.

android.title: Account name
items: Settings: the name of your account is part of Manage profile.

android.title: Full-size phone icon
items: The app icon on phones is full size again; TVs keep their home-screen icon.

android.title: Support window + updates
items: The Technical Support window fits every TV.
Hide categories: Done keeps you on that row.
Updates are checked from this download page.

android.title: Support window fixes
items: The Technical Support window keeps its title and text in view.
Done in Hide categories stays on its row.

android.title: Update messages
items: The update message also shows when you come back to the app.
The Updates button moved to the bottom-left corner.

android.title: Smoother screens, Hide categories, self-updating app
items: The app downloads and installs its own updates.
Settings > Hide categories; Live TV group names without star symbols.
Technical Support with a QR code.
No black fade between screens.

android.title: Ratings, grid view, steadier player
items: Title pages show the age rating and IMDb score.
Live TV Grid view.
Section counts saved and shown at once.
A freeze after waking the TV fixed; the player kept on its steadiest settings.

android.title: Continue watching on every device
items: Stop a movie or episode on one device and finish it on another.
Sharp backgrounds for movies and series, instant Back.
Live channels that stall reconnect quietly.

android.title: Trailers, themes and weather
items: Trailer button on movie and series pages.
Long names slide sideways while highlighted.
Eagle Lake theme; weather shows at once and retries by itself.
A fresh install opens on Home without asking for a login first.

android.title: Games widget, backgrounds, Picture size
items: Today's games on Home (NFL, NBA, MLB, Soccer).
Backgrounds from TMDB when the provider has none.
Picture size menu; the player shows the time left.
"Show more" for long stories, Arabic text from the right.

windows.title: Full-page Home banner
items: The featured movies and shows at the top of Home now fill the whole screen with a sharper picture, so faces are no longer cut off. Scroll down for Continue watching and the other rows. The slow zoom stays.

windows.title: Hide a Home row
items: New: Settings > Home screen > Hide a Home row. You can hide any row the app puts on the Home page (and show it again).
The Tonight's Pick mood row is removed from the Home page.
The small trash-can icon is removed from the Remove button.

windows.title: Cleaner screens, Arabic fixes
items: The keyboard shortcut hints are gone from every screen (Settings, Search, the choose windows and the small hover tips). The keys still work.
Arabic: the title page background picture looks like English (the sharp person is no longer hidden behind the dark side).
Arabic and Spanish: the line "5 versions available: 4K . Full HD ..." is fully translated.

windows.title: Arabic actor name fix
items: Arabic: the actor's name in the top bar (when you scroll down) also keeps its dot / Jr. at the end.

windows.title: Arabic arrows, plain buttons
items: Arabic: the arrows at the sides of the rows point the same way as in English.
The Edit, Save, Telegram and Write-an-email buttons show words only, without small icons.

windows.title: Arabic: Cairo is now the standard Arabic font (you can st…
items: Arabic: Cairo is now the standard Arabic font (you can still switch to the usual Windows font in Settings > Home screen > Language).

windows.title: Search for actors and directors: the Search page shows an…
items: Search for actors and directors: the Search page shows an Actors and Directors row above the posters when you type a name, and the Actors and Directors page has its own search box. Only people who have a title in your library are shown.
Arabic: an actor's name keeps its dot / Jr. at the end (it was moved to the front).

windows.title: Search (Premiere) and My List: posters that were missing …
items: Search (Premiere) and My List: posters that were missing in search but fine in the Movies section now show the same checked poster, and are looked up again if the service's picture fails.
The Arabic font choice is the usual font or Cairo (Readex Pro was taken out).

windows.title: New "Text size" choice in Settings > Home screen > Langua…
items: New "Text size" choice in Settings > Home screen > Language (Normal, 95%, 90%, 85%, 80%): makes all the letters in the app a little smaller, in every language; changes at once.
The Edit button of your accounts has a modern pencil icon.

windows.title: Arabic: the mood tiles on the Premiere Home (Tonight's Pi…
items: Arabic: the mood tiles on the Premiere Home (Tonight's Pick) no longer cut the bottom of the letters in the title.

windows.title: Arabic: a new "Arabic font" choice in Settings > Home scr…
items: Arabic: a new "Arabic font" choice in Settings > Home screen > Language (visible when the language is Arabic): the usual Windows font or Cairo. The chosen font is used for all Arabic text in the app.

windows.title: Premiere Home: the five "Tonight's Pick" mood tiles fill …
items: Premiere Home: the five "Tonight's Pick" mood tiles fill the whole width of the window (no sideways scrolling), and long titles wrap instead of being cut.

windows.title: Download is for movies only (the episode download button …
items: Download is for movies only (the episode download button was taken out again).

windows.title: Arabic: the full-screen Live TV clock uses Arabic digits,…
items: Arabic: the full-screen Live TV clock uses Arabic digits, and the Picture size button is translated.
Your provider's category names now always show exactly as the provider wrote them (the 1.40.0 word translation was removed).
When the app hides to the system tray during a download, a message tells you where it went and the tray icon shows the download percentage.

windows.title: Settings: the category names (My TV services, Home screen…
items: Settings: the category names (My TV services, Home screen, Playback ...) stay on one line in every language.
Download: a movie with several versions (4K, Full HD, HD ...) first asks which quality to download and shows each size.
New switch Settings > Playback > System: keep the app running in the system tray while a download runs; closing the window during a download asks (or follows the switch).
Theme names: Barca Colors (ألوان برشلونة) and the Barcelona photo theme.

windows.title: A star on each poster of the Premiere theme (home rows, T…
items: A star on each poster of the Premiere theme (home rows, Top 10, genre / collection lists, search, More like this): hollow on hover, gold once the title is in My List; one click adds or removes it.

windows.title: The More info button on the Premiere home uses a modern l…
items: The More info button on the Premiere home uses a modern line icon (all languages).

windows.title: My List: a "My List" button in the Premiere top bar, a My…
items: My List: a "My List" button in the Premiere top bar, a My List item in the side menu and a My List row on the Home page (under Continue watching) all open your saved movies and series.
The My List page has All / Movies / Series tabs; a small gold star on each poster (or the Delete key) removes a title.

windows.title: Parental control: when protection is turned OFF the PIN i…
items: Parental control: when protection is turned OFF the PIN is never asked again (Settings and the Parental control group open freely, so you can switch it on again). The PIN and rules stay saved.

windows.title: Settings groups: the gold highlight stays on the open gro…
items: Settings groups: the gold highlight stays on the open group and no longer follows the mouse (no flicker); the mouse only brightens a group a little.

windows.title: Collection cards on the Premiere home: the posters have t…
items: Collection cards on the Premiere home: the posters have their own column, long titles can never touch them.
Search: posters are retried and start loading at once, so fewer cards stay text-only; the side-menu Search returns to the page you came from.

Arabic: Back from an actor / list returns to the same place in a row; clearer wording (جاري التحميل, إدارة اخفاء الباقات, channel row title); lengths spelled out in row subtitles and "in 1h 20m" tags; tanwin written ـاً.
The website button always opens the site at the top (it starts in English, light theme).

windows.title: Arabic: scroll bar flush on the far left; arrows of the f…
items: Arabic: scroll bar flush on the far left; arrows of the featured title on the left; clock, temperature and date in Arabic digits on the Premiere home; "شاهد المزيد" with a left-pointing arrow.
Arabic lengths are spelled out (ساعتين و30 دقيقة).
Window title is "Cinema Premiere IPTV" in every language.
Settings group highlight redesigned: gold glass bar that glides, text never changes colour (no flicker).
Live channel cards on the Premiere home show the full name.

windows.title: Thick scroll bar also in Arabic (on the left) and on the …
items: Thick scroll bar also in Arabic (on the left) and on the Sports page.
Settings groups: smooth highlight, no flicker.
Search button in the side menu.
Theme names readable on the picture cards; modern Internet icon.
Arabic: clearer Settings names; Arabic digits in the Home weather and clock bar.

windows.title: The whole app now speaks Arabic and Spanish
items: The whole app now speaks Arabic and Spanish. Settings > Language switches at once and is remembered.
Arabic is mirrored right to left; the video player and the PIN keypad stay as they are.
Movie and series stories show in your language when available.

windows.title: The e-mail code box shows six dots, one for each digit of…
items: The e-mail code box shows six dots, one for each digit of the code.

windows.title: PIN recovery e-mails are sent from the app's own address
items: PIN recovery e-mails are sent from the app's own address.

windows.title: PIN recovery by e-mail is switched on: Forgot your PIN? s…
items: PIN recovery by e-mail is switched on: Forgot your PIN? sends a 6-digit code to the recovery e-mail.

windows.title: PIN recovery sends one code per hour
items: PIN recovery sends one code per hour.

windows.title: PIN recovery by e-mail: when you set a PIN you can save a…
items: PIN recovery by e-mail: when you set a PIN you can save a recovery e-mail. If you forget the PIN, the app e-mails a 6-digit code and the right code lets you choose a new PIN. You can add or change the e-mail in Settings > Parental control.

windows.title: Settings asks for the PIN every time you open it
items: Settings asks for the PIN every time you open it. A forgotten PIN can no longer be reset with the IPTV password (e-mail recovery is being prepared).

windows.title: Settings is easier to read on every theme: the cards, the…
items: Settings is easier to read on every theme: the cards, the group buttons and the heading now have a dark background, so wallpaper themes no longer clash with the text.

windows.title: New Parental Control in Settings: choose a PIN, protect a…
items: New Parental Control in Settings: choose a PIN, protect adult categories and your own words in Live TV, Movies and Series, set an age limit for movies and series, and lock Settings. Protected content stays hidden until you unlock it with the PIN (a gold lock button appears), and locks again by itself.

windows.title: A cleaner, modern Download button with a line icon: it sh…
items: A cleaner, modern Download button with a line icon: it shows a cross while downloading and a tick when the movie is saved.

windows.title: The download review window has a new look that matches th…
items: The download review window has a new look that matches the app, with a storage bar that shows how much room the movie takes. The Movies and Series pages now also have the Cast & Crew row: click a person to see everything they are in.

windows.title: Before a movie download starts, a review window shows the…
items: Before a movie download starts, a review window shows the exact size, where it will be saved and how much free space your PC has. Press Proceed to start or Cancel to stop.

windows.title: On a movie or series page, click any actor or the directo…
items: On a movie or series page, click any actor or the director in the Cast & Crew row to see every title they are in. Back returns to the same movie page.

windows.title: A Download button on every movie page (next to Trailer): …
items: A Download button on every movie page (next to Trailer): saves the movie on your PC in Downloads > Cinema Premiere IPTV. It shows the progress, a second click cancels, and when it is finished the button says Downloaded (click it to open the folder).

windows.title: On an actor's page, the actor's picture appears next to t…
items: On an actor's page, the actor's picture appears next to the name in the title bar as you scroll down and fades away when you go back to the top.

windows.title: Settings: the key boxes (movie info and IMDb scores) show…
items: Settings: the key boxes (movie info and IMDb scores) show only one eye to reveal the key.

windows.title: The Sports Hub starts with no followed team on a new inst…
items: The Sports Hub starts with no followed team on a new install (you pick your own); the Home card teams are not copied in for you.

windows.title: New Sports Hub (a Sports button on the Home screen and in…
items: New Sports Hub (a Sports button on the Home screen and in the menus): live scores, today's games, standings, teams and match pages with highlight videos for soccer, basketball, football, baseball, hockey, F1, tennis, UFC, golf and rugby. Follow your teams and leagues, and see the next big game in a spotlight with a countdown. Everything comes from free sports feeds and is loaded only while the Sports Hub is open.

windows.title: Series that a provider lists season by season (for exampl…
items: Series that a provider lists season by season (for example "Name 3" or "Name 1&2") are matched to their one real series in the movie database, so every season card gets the right poster, story and background. The automatic poster check now also covers series whose name has no year.

windows.title: Genre pages group movies by their main genres (a film app…
items: Genre pages group movies by their main genres (a film appears in a genre only when that genre is one of its first two), so Comedy no longer holds horror, animation and thrillers. The series check is much faster: the page starts at once and the rest is added as it is checked.

windows.title: Genre pages use IMDb's own genre list as the tie-breaker:…
items: Genre pages use IMDb's own genre list as the tie-breaker: only for the few series that the other genre sources are unsure about, and only when you have your own OMDb key (Settings). Where the other sources are sure they decide, so nothing is slower or limited.

windows.title: Genre pages take a second look at every series: it is che…
items: Genre pages take a second look at every series: it is checked once against a free genre list (TVmaze) and the movie database's keywords, so shows like Black Mirror leave Horror and Better Call Saul leaves Romance. Every answer is kept on your PC, so each show is checked only once.

windows.title: Genre pages: the Series side of every genre is now built …
items: Genre pages: the Series side of every genre is now built from the movie database's genres AND keywords (Romance, Thriller, Horror, History, War, Music, Adventure, Fantasy and the rest), so a series lands in the group it really belongs to.

windows.title: The Romance genre page now lists real romance series (TV …
items: The Romance genre page now lists real romance series (TV has no Romance genre in the movie database, the page used Drama before).

windows.title: The last circle of the Actors and Directors row is now a …
items: The last circle of the Actors and Directors row is now a modern gold arrow, centred. Settings says that added rows work only on the Cinema Premiere theme.

windows.title: Add your own rows to the Cinema Premiere Home page: Setti…
items: Add your own rows to the Cinema Premiere Home page: Settings > Home screen > Add a row to the Home page. Choose a Movies, Series or Live TV section (with its number of titles) and it becomes a row under Continue watching; choose it again to remove it.

windows.title: Automatic poster fix: while you browse Movies and Series,…
items: Automatic poster fix: while you browse Movies and Series, the app quietly checks each title that shows a year in its name against the movie database and replaces a wrong or different provider picture with the real poster. It runs only when nothing is moving or playing, and remembers every answer.

windows.title: Wrong posters fixed: when a provider's picture is of anot…
items: Wrong posters fixed: when a provider's picture is of another film, the real movie poster replaces it on the card as soon as you point at the title or open it, and is remembered. The year in names like "Name - 2026 [HD]" is now read, so Arabic films are no longer matched to an older film with the same name.
Live TV: the clock under the preview is now plain and small.

windows.title: A plain small clock icon on Recently watched
items: A plain small clock icon on Recently watched. Arabic series are matched to the movie database even when the provider spells the name differently, so more of them get their proper poster and background.

windows.title: TV guide for every channel: when your provider sends no g…
items: TV guide for every channel: when your provider sends no guide for a channel (or you use a playlist), the app now finds Now / Next / Later by channel name from free public TV guides (Arab countries, US, UK, Canada, Europe and more), like the Android TV app.

windows.title: Series and movies that are not originally English (for ex…
items: Series and movies that are not originally English (for example Turkish series) now get the poster, the title picture and the sharpest text-free background in their own language from the movie database.

windows.title: Choose a version can no longer open twice on top of each …
items: Choose a version can no longer open twice on top of each other: a second click is ignored while the versions are being looked up, and only one window can exist.

windows.title: The app logo now shows next to the name in Settings > Hel…
items: The app logo now shows next to the name in Settings > Help & about. The public download file is now named Cinema-Premiere-IPTV-Setup.exe.

windows.title: Fixed the Movies and Series pages: scrolling works again …
items: Fixed the Movies and Series pages: scrolling works again and the movie / series page shows its full background picture.

windows.title: Search (Premiere) looks through every saved account; the …
items: Search (Premiere) looks through every saved account; the Movies and Series pages still search only the account chosen in their drop-down.

windows.title: A new account you save is read quietly in the background …
items: A new account you save is read quietly in the background right away, so it is ready before you open a movie page. A removed account leaves the lists at once.

windows.title: Movies and Series pages keep each provider's own content:…
items: Movies and Series pages keep each provider's own content: a drop-down next to the search box chooses which saved account you browse. Home, Search and the title pages still look through every account.

windows.title: Movies and Series sections can now include the titles of …
items: Movies and Series sections can now include the titles of every saved account (replaced in 1.25.1 by the account drop-down).

windows.title: Genre, collection and Home row pages count the titles of …
items: Genre, collection and Home row pages count the titles of every saved account, in the background and without slowing the app. A title from another account plays without switching accounts.

windows.title: A Continue watching card opens the title page only; the C…
items: A Continue watching card opens the title page only; the Choose a version window appears when you press Watch now.

windows.title: Choose a version no longer gets skipped: an old saved lis…
items: Choose a version no longer gets skipped: an old saved list with one copy is never trusted while the library is still loading.

windows.title: Several Xtream accounts: Choose a version offers every co…
items: Several Xtream accounts: Choose a version offers every copy of a title on every saved account, with the account shown on each row, and plays a copy from its own account without switching.

windows.title: Show / hide password eye on every password box
items: Show / hide password eye on every password box. The play icon is centred in its circle. The small Live TV window can be dragged anywhere on the screen.

windows.title: Movies and series: a Subtitles and audio button (like on …
items: Movies and series: a Subtitles and audio button (like on the TV app) to pick the audio language and subtitles, also for titles marked MULTI.

windows.title: X close button on the version windows
items: X close button on the version windows. Arabic descriptions stay Arabic. Sharp, exact-resolution backgrounds. Saved lists can never stall the screen.

windows.title: The IMDb badge is taken from the exact title everywhere
items: The IMDb badge is taken from the exact title everywhere.

windows.title: Movies and Series pages open instantly with no Loading sc…
items: Movies and Series pages open instantly with no Loading screen; the movie database decides the exact title first, and Choose a version also works there.

windows.title: Exact backgrounds from the provider's movie number, detai…
items: Exact backgrounds from the provider's movie number, details prepared when the mouse rests on a poster, modern Back button on the Movies / Series pages.

windows.title: Faster posters (small saved thumbnails), pictures loaded …
items: Faster posters (small saved thumbnails), pictures loaded ahead, long genre pages built only near the screen, title pages prepared ahead, and pictures retried automatically.

windows.title: Movies and Series sections are counted once and saved on …
items: Movies and Series sections are counted once and saved on the PC; only new titles raise the numbers.

windows.title: Dark pause / play icon on the gold button and thinner 10 …
items: Dark pause / play icon on the gold button and thinner 10 second icons.

windows.title: Genre and collection pages are counted once, saved, and o…
items: Genre and collection pages are counted once, saved, and only topped up quietly.

windows.title: Fixed a short freeze when leaving a page
items: Fixed a short freeze when leaving a page.

windows.title: The mouse wheel over the small player window never change…
items: The mouse wheel over the small player window never changes the volume. Smoother Back while a movie plays in the small window.

windows.title: The mini window of the player is now the app's own small …
items: The mini window of the player is now the app's own small floating player (bottom right): drag it anywhere, double-click it or press its first button to go back to full screen, X closes the movie, the round button pauses. It keeps playing while you browse the app.
Brightness: scroll the mouse wheel on the left side of the player to change it, like the volume on the right.

windows.title: Mini PiP window: the player screen now goes away and you …
items: Mini PiP window: the player screen now goes away and you land on the Home page while the movie keeps playing in the small window, so you can browse anywhere. Double-click the small window (or close it / send it back) and the movie comes back in full screen.
Choose a version now shows which account the title comes from, with a small account icon, in the header and on every version.
Going Back to a Premiere page puts every row at the same sideways place, not at the far left.
Modern Back 10 / Forward 10 buttons in the player.

windows.title: New movie and series player controls
items: New movie and series player controls. The round gold Play / Pause button sits in the middle of the bottom bar (clicking the picture no longer pauses), with Back 10 and Forward 10 beside it.
New buttons on the right of the bar: Lock Screen, Mini PiP Window, Screen Size and Full screen. Each shows a small label when you point at it.
Volume slider on the right side of the screen and Brightness slider on the left side. Mouse wheel also changes the volume; keys: Up / Down volume, M mute, L lock, F full screen.

windows.title: Speed check of the new screens: the Welcome screen uses m…
items: Speed check of the new screens: the Welcome screen uses much less power, Slow-PC mode now also switches the page fade off, and at most 3 pages are kept for Back.

windows.title: New installs start with Today's games and Score cards swi…
items: New installs start with Today's games and Score cards switched off (you can turn them on in Settings > Home screen). People who already use the app keep their setting.
The "not available on Premiere" notes have a modern icon.

windows.title: Going back no longer flashes
items: Going back no longer flashes. When you open a movie, an actor or a list from a Premiere page and press Back, the page you left is put back exactly as it was: same scroll place, same selected card, nothing rebuilt. Pages now cross-fade smoothly when you move between them.

windows.title: The Back button that appears while you scroll down now si…
items: The Back button that appears while you scroll down now sits at the top left, level with the top bar.

windows.title: On the genre, actor and Actors and Directors pages the Ba…
items: On the genre, actor and Actors and Directors pages the Back button also appears at the top right while you scroll down. All Back buttons now have a modern arrow icon.

windows.title: The Device profile drop-down (Stalker / MAG) now shows ev…
items: The Device profile drop-down (Stalker / MAG) now shows every choice clearly (white names on a dark list).

windows.title: Genre, collection, actor and Actors and Directors pages n…
items: Genre, collection, actor and Actors and Directors pages now have a Back button. Back (and Esc) returns to the page and the place you opened it from, for example the same row on the home page.

windows.title: Settings > My TV services: a new "Stalker / MAG portal" card
items: Settings > My TV services: a new "Stalker / MAG portal" card. Add a portal address + MAC address; it appears with your channel lists and in Live TV (Live TV only).

windows.title: Settings > Help & about: a Legal Disclaimer card (the app…
items: Settings > Help & about: a Legal Disclaimer card (the app is only a player, you add your own sources, picture and TMDB credits).

windows.title: Settings > My TV services: new box "Add from your provide…
items: Settings > My TV services: new box "Add from your provider" (like the Android app). It shows this PC's MAC Address and Device Key and a QR code. Your provider (or you, from a phone) opens the website page, types them with an Xtream login or an M3U link, and it is added to the app. Nothing is replaced; if the app has no login yet, it signs in at once.

windows.title: New sign-in option: Stalker / MAG portal (portal address …
items: New sign-in option: Stalker / MAG portal (portal address + MAC address + device profile). Live TV works with it; Movies and Series from a portal come later.

windows.title: Settings > Home screen: Today's games and Score cards now…
items: Settings > Home screen: Today's games and Score cards now say they are not available on the Cinema Premiere theme (they work on the other themes).

windows.title: New Welcome screen for a first start: pick your look - Cl…
items: New Welcome screen for a first start: pick your look - Classic (big tiles), Premiere (cinema style) or Gallery (photo wallpapers: Barcelona, Real Madrid, Eagle Lake).

You no longer have to enter an IPTV account to start. The app opens right away with a notice to add your Xtream or M3U details later in Settings > My TV services (or press 'I have an IPTV account' on the Welcome screen).

windows.title: Settings > My Xtream accounts: a new Edit button lets you…
items: Settings > My Xtream accounts: a new Edit button lets you change an account's name, server, username and password. Hidden categories stay with the account.

windows.title: Updating from an older version now opens the new Cinema P…
items: Updating from an older version now opens the new Cinema Premiere theme automatically (once). You can pick another theme any time in Settings > Home screen > Theme.

windows.title: The "A new version is available" message has a modern ico…
items: The "A new version is available" message has a modern icon and modern button icons instead of the old arrow symbols.

windows.title: The Live TV button in the top bar opens the Live TV secti…
items: The Live TV button in the top bar opens the Live TV section again (it no longer jumps into the last channel you watched). Clicking a card in Recently watched channels still opens that channel.

windows.title: In the shrunk top bar the time now sits exactly in the mi…
items: In the shrunk top bar the time now sits exactly in the middle, level with the weather and the menu.

windows.title: The app is now called Cinema Premiere IPTV (installer, St…
items: The app is now called Cinema Premiere IPTV (installer, Start menu, desktop shortcut, support messages). Your settings, logins and Continue watching are kept.

windows.title: The top bar now shrinks with a smooth cinematic glide (0.…
items: The top bar now shrinks with a smooth cinematic glide (0.7 s): Cinema Premiere and the weather + clock slide in beside the menu, the menu gets smaller and the date fades out. No more jitter, and no flicker around the scroll line.
Poster cards in long lists pop out properly again (the lift, the frame and the name below it are no longer cut off).

windows.title: Premiere section pages: when you scroll into a page with …
items: Premiere section pages: when you scroll into a page with a title bar (a genre, a collection, a franchise, a person, Actors and Directors, a title page, Search) the top bar and the title bar now share ONE background (with the page colour glowing from the left); the top bar gets slim and tiny and Cinema Premiere and the weather + clock move in beside the menu, while the page title (like Action) is bigger and clear. The home page keeps its normal top bar.
The name under a poster steps down a little when you point at it, so it no longer touches the frame.

windows.title: Premiere: scrolling a page (a genre, a collection, a fran…
items: Premiere: scrolling a page (a genre, a collection, a franchise, a person, Actors and Directors, a title page, Search) shows a bar under the top bar with the page name, e.g. Action, so you always know where you are; on the right it shows the name and year of the poster under the pointer.
Actors and Directors lists everyone with titles in your library, sorted A-Z, with no See more button: more people slip into place while the page is open.

windows.title: Premiere home, more to discover: an Explore banner and Co…
items: Premiere home, more to discover: an Explore banner and Collections (Oscar / Emmy / Golden Globe winners, Hidden Gems, Cult Classics, Documentaries, Christmas in the season and more), Because you watched, Recommended for you, Tonight's Pick (five moods), Got 90 minutes?, Popular Actors and Directors (with a See more page), Franchises and Movie Universes, Epic Nights and Browse by Genre. Every card opens its own page with Movies and Series tabs that keep filling with the titles your service has. Only titles you can play are shown.

Faster and lighter: long lists only draw what is on screen, missing posters are looked up once and remembered, and a new Slow-PC mode (Settings > Playback: Automatic / On / Off) gives older PCs a lighter look.

windows.title: Premiere search also opens with Ctrl+F (the usual Windows…
items: Premiere search also opens with Ctrl+F (the usual Windows search key); Ctrl+K still works.

windows.title: Premiere SEARCH: press Ctrl+K (or the Search button of th…
items: Premiere SEARCH: press Ctrl+K (or the Search button of the top bar) on the Premiere home or a title page. Type and the movies and series of your service appear at once (best matches first; English and Arabic; the same title in a different year shows as its own title). Point at a poster to see its story, year, length, genres and score on a big backdrop. Your last searches and the first results show as buttons. Arrow keys, Enter to open, Esc to close; Back from a title returns to the search.

windows.title: Leaving a channel that was opened from the Premiere pages…
items: Leaving a channel that was opened from the Premiere pages (Esc / Back) now goes straight to the Premiere home; the Live TV list no longer flashes on the way.

Settings > Content & search > Movie & Series info: step 1 now has two buttons, "Create a free account" (TMDB sign-up page) and "I have an account: open my API page" (TMDB shows the API page of the account you are signed in to), with clearer words.

windows.title: Premiere: the Live TV button in the top bar (and the Rece…
items: Premiere: the Live TV button in the top bar (and the Recently watched channels cards) now opens your last channel straight in full screen. Back / Esc returns to the Premiere page you came from (the channel keeps playing in the small corner player).

windows.title: Settings > Content & search: two new cards, "Movie & Seri…
items: Settings > Content & search: two new cards, "Movie & Series info" (TMDB) and "IMDb scores" (OMDb). The app already works with a shared key; you can add a FREE key of your own (three simple steps, a button opens the sign-up page). The app tests the key before saving it, keeps it only on this PC, and you can remove it any time.

windows.title: Premiere title pages have a Home button in the top bar (a…
items: Premiere title pages have a Home button in the top bar (a quick way back to the Premiere home, next to Back).
The scroll bar grows thicker still when the mouse comes near it.

windows.title: Choose a version now shows every time you press Watch now…
items: Choose a version now shows every time you press Watch now (also when you continue a movie); after you pick a version, a window asks Resume from 10:25 or Start from the beginning when that version (or another version of the same title) has a stop point. The page itself just says Watch now.
Continue watching cards on the Premiere home open the Premiere title page (with those windows), and Back returns to the Premiere home at the same place (it used to open the Movies section).
Faster: the library is prepared in the background while the home is shown, the versions of a title are remembered, and the movie's details are fetched as soon as its page opens.

The mouse wheel over a row now always moves that row sideways, also at its ends (it no longer jumps on to the next row); move the pointer off the rows (titles, the big picture, blank space or the scroll bar) to scroll the page.

windows.title: Choose a version now always appears when your service has…
items: Choose a version now always appears when your service has more than one copy of a title (it was skipped when you pressed Watch now before the library had finished loading; the button now waits a moment for it).
Settings: the white highlight in the group list glides to the group under the mouse, like the top bar of the Premiere home, and rests on the open group.
Scroll bars are wider and, when the mouse comes near the right edge, grow thick and bright so they are easy to grab.

windows.title: Premiere: the new TITLE PAGE
items: Premiere: the new TITLE PAGE. Click a poster or More info on the Premiere home: full backdrop, title logo, age rating, IMDb score, tagline, story, awards (like Won 3 Oscars), director / creator, Watch now / Resume / Start over, Trailer, My List, season + episode cards for series, Cast & Crew and More like this (only titles in your library). When your service has several copies of a title, Choose a version lists them (4K, Full HD, HD, language, subtitles). Esc or Back returns to where you were.
The previous / next buttons on the featured titles are redrawn so the arrows sit exactly in the middle of the circles.

windows.title: Premiere home: ‹ and › buttons on the featured titles (ri…
items: Premiere home: ‹ and › buttons on the featured titles (right side) to flip to the previous / next title yourself (the automatic flip waits 5 seconds again after you use them).
The mouse wheel over a row now moves the row more than twice as far per click.

windows.title: Premiere home: cards now sit neatly inside their highligh…
items: Premiere home: cards now sit neatly inside their highlight frame (Continue watching, Recently watched channels, posters), the arrow at the end of a row stays visible over a highlighted poster, and the mouse wheel over a row moves that row sideways (at the end of the row it scrolls the page again).

windows.title: New theme "Premiere" (Settings > Home screen > Theme, fir…
items: New theme "Premiere" (Settings > Home screen > Theme, first in the list): the Cinema Premiere home of the TV app. A top bar with a gliding menu and the weather + clock, a hero reel of 10 featured titles (title logo, IMDb score, age rating), Continue watching, Recently watched channels, Top 10 Movies and TV Shows with tall gold numbers, Hot & Trending and New Releases. Everything shown is in your own library. Use the mouse or the arrow keys; Esc goes back to the top.

windows.title: Settings looks like the TV app: a list of groups on the l…
items: Settings looks like the TV app: a list of groups on the left (My TV services, Home screen, Playback, Content & search, Internet, Help & about) and the cards of the chosen group on the right.

New: a 12 / 24-hour clock switch (Weather & clock), Show the TV guide On / Off (Playback), Clear watch history (Content & search), an Internet speed test with a speedometer, Reload channels (My TV services) and Check for updates (Help & about).
Score cards and Today's games are now two separate cards.
Score cards: the "Back to Barça + Lakers" button is gone.

windows.title: A new app icon with more space around the IPTV emblem
items: A new app icon with more space around the IPTV emblem.
Technical Support: the website button no longer repeats the web address next to it.

windows.title: Smoother sync and ratings for everyone
items: Continue watching sync is lighter: it only downloads your list when something changed, so it keeps working smoothly for everyone.
IMDb scores are remembered on your PC for a week, so title pages open with the score right away.

windows.title: Live games on the sports card
items: Home sports card: a live game of your teams now looks like the live games in the list (score in the middle, game clock under it, in red).
Home sports card: tighter spacing, so more games fit without scrolling.

windows.title: Website button in Technical Support
items: Settings > Technical Support: a button opens the download page with the update history.

windows.title: Sharper look + wheel scrolling
items: Home: the mouse wheel over the sports card scrolls the games list.
Sharper look: Windows' own screen font (Segoe UI), smooth new Home icons, team logos at the size they are shown.

windows.title: ✨ Recently added icon
items: Movies / Series: "Recently added" uses the same ✨ as the TV app.

windows.title: Live scores in place, rows in full
items: Home sports card: a live game's score stays in its row.
Continue watching and Recently watched channels show in full.

windows.title: Faster posters + new Home
items: Faster Movies / Series: posters stay on screen while the season bars come in, a section you already opened shows at once, and resting the mouse on a section gets it ready before you click.
Smoother Live TV list scrolling.
New Home like the TV app: a slim weather + clock bar and one sports card with your teams and today's games (sport drop-down + Yesterday / Today / Upcoming).

windows.title: New app icon
items: The gold IPTV shield icon, the same as the TV and phone app.

windows.title: Season bars remembered
items: Series posters: season / episode bars are remembered between starts, and a failed lookup is tried again.

windows.title: NEW episode bar everywhere
items: The green NEW season / episode bar shows in every section, checked again every 6 hours.

windows.title: Every account in Hide categories
items: Hide categories: every saved Xtream account has its own Live TV / Movies / Series; 📡 / 📋 icons.

windows.title: Switch accounts from Live TV
items: Live TV: your other Xtream accounts are buttons next to Search.
Rename each playlist and account in Settings.

windows.title: Hide categories polish
items: The "List:" row is above Live TV / Movies / Series.

windows.title: Easier scroll bars
items: Home: thicker scroll bars under Continue watching and Recently watched channels.

windows.title: Several accounts
items: Save more than one provider login and switch between them.
Every account and playlist has its own hidden categories.

windows.title: Telegram support
items: Technical Support: a Telegram button.
The highlight of the first poster column is no longer cut off.

windows.title: Account name at sign-in
items: Enter your account name in the sign-in window.

windows.title: Whole posters
items: Title pages show the whole poster; the poster highlight shows on all four sides.

windows.title: Updates inside the app
items: "Download and install" installs a new version and opens the app again - settings, favorites and login stay.

windows.title: Continue watching everywhere, ratings, Hide categories
items: Continue watching across your devices.
Age rating + IMDb score; Live TV Grid view.
Hide categories; Technical Support; an Updates button.

windows.title: Trailers, themes, score cards
items: Trailer button (real trailers only), Eagle Lake theme, sliding long names.
Weather shows at once and retries; choose your teams for the score cards.

windows.title: TV guide, corner player, more channels play
items: TV guide with catch-up, Channel check, a small corner player.
4K / HEVC channels play; Picture size; time left in the player; TMDB backgrounds.
